title: Optimising Compiler for C0
description: A complete optimising compiler in Rust: SSA construction, field-sensitive alias analysis, inter-procedural purity, LICM and inlining, with a full x86-64 backend (chordal graph-colouring register allocation with MCS ordering, LEA folding). 14–72% runtime speedups on kernels, within 6% of GCC -O1 on real benchmarks, with 24% smaller binaries.

title: Municipal Bond Underpricing Detection
description: A fair-value pricing engine (NSS yield curves, CatBoost) over 70M+ municipal bond trades that computes benchmark yields and mispricing spreads, giving a per-underwriter audit signal. Estimated $480M+ in annual issuer overpayment by stripping Treasury rate moves from post-issuance prices, and surfaced 1,994 direct pricing-rule violations. Presented as a research poster at CMU's Meeting of the Minds symposium.

title: Speculative Execution Vulnerability Classifier
description: An end-to-end system (corpus synthesis, ISA spec engine, GNN classifier, hardware and symbolic validation oracles) that classifies raw assembly into Spectre, L1TF, MDS and RETBLEED vulnerability classes across x86-64, ARM64 and RISC-V at 96% accuracy, plus a class-conditioned transformer that generates synthetic vulnerable assembly.

title: SATOR Ops
description: A full-stack decision system: Next.js dashboard, FastAPI backend with REST and WebSockets, Postgres, and a shared-types monorepo under Docker. It cross-validates sensor telemetry against vision data to flag physically impossible states, records each decision in a hash-chained audit log, and anchors the final artifact hash on Solana.

title: MIT Battlecode 2025
description: Global top 11 among 1000+ teams: low-latency multi-agent bots with bug-algorithm pathfinding.

title: Citadel Terminal Europe 2025
description: 6th in Europe of 40 invited teams: adaptive algos that infer opponent strategy from observed play and rebalance attack and defence each turn under a hard resource budget, using BFS search heuristics and DP.

title: ScottyLabs Agentic CRM
description: An agentic CRM that learns how ScottyLabs matches student teams with partner projects: a chat-style AI concierge that onboards staff into a knowledge base, auto-generated student group profiles for matching, and agents that qualify inbound partner leads through a pipeline.

title: Cyber Café Simulation
description: A nostalgic 90s cyber café built at HackCMU: classic arcade games (Snake, Pac-Man, Space Invaders, Tetris, Pong), accounts, leaderboards and saved game state behind a retro CRT-styled UI.

title: This Portfolio
description: A first-person 3D desk where every object opens a section, built with three.js, GSAP and a Blender-generated asset kit.

title: Dynamic Report Generator
description: A full-stack app that connects to a MySQL database, joins chosen tables, and builds custom reports with sorting, date ranges, search, AND/OR filters, and CSV or Excel export.

title: Full Stack Notes App
description: A Flask notes app storing users and notes in MySQL, caching sessions in Redis and logging activity to MongoDB, fully containerised with Docker.

title: ChipIn AI Backend
description: A REST API with user registration, email confirmation and JWT authentication, deployed with Docker.

title: Steam Catalog Insights
description: Data analysis over a Steam video game catalog: game details, genres, tags, reviews and SteamSpy sales and playtime estimates.

title: Hula Hoops
description: Travel companion web app built at HackTheBurgh.
